AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned and optional Cursor for the starting point of data.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Enterprises. If not specified, the operation returns data for all enterprises within scope of the Access Token.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Interval in which the products were updated.

IncludeDefault.description: Whether or not to include default products for the service, i.e. products which are standard includes and not true extras. For example, the night's stay would be the default product for a room reservation. These may be useful for accounting purposes but should not be displayed to customers for selection. If `ProductIds` are provided, `IncludeDefault` defaults to true, otherwise it defaults to false.
